maddeler.e: قُرْوُسْطِيّ • (qurwusṭiyy) (feminine قُرْوُسْطِيَّة (qurwusṭiyya), masculine plural قُرْوُسْطِيُّون (qurwusṭiyyūn), feminine plural قُرْوُسْطِيَّات (qurwusṭiyyāt))
maddeler.t:
From the univerbation of الْقُرُون الْوُسْطَى (al-qurūn al-wusṭā, “the Middle Ages”) + ـِيّ (-iyy, nisba suffix).
Compare شَرْق أَوْسَطِيّ (šarq ʔawsaṭiyy) / شَرْقَوْسَطِيّ (šarqawsaṭiyy, “Middle Eastern”), a similarly built neologism.
s: univerbation of الْقُرُون الْوُسْطَى (al-qurūn al-wusṭā, “the Middle Ages”)
